summary_md: **Shadab Shams ([@ShadabLoveAi](https://x.com/ShadabLoveAi/status/2116065134468853952))** highlights **AutoShorts**, an open-source, local-first desktop take on Opus Clip that finds and ranks viral moments in long videos, auto-crops to 9:16 with FFmpeg and adds animated captions ([JayWebtech/autoshorts](https://github.com/JayWebtech/autoshorts)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - JayWebtech/autoshorts: AutoShorts is a local-first desktop application for turning long-form video or audio recordings into high-impact, vertical short-form clip candidates (9:16 portrait) with AI-powered viral moment ranking.

relevance: Local automated short-form video editing pipeline.
